say:1:1035246001:0.text: A bunch of con artists came and told everyone to leave for Holistone because golems were supposedly coming.
say:1:1035246001:0.source_cn: 还不是镇上那些家伙，说什么魔偶可能来袭击，让我们全去圣...
say:1:1035246001:0.male: A bunch of con artists came and told everyone to leave for Holistone because golems were supposedly coming.
say:1:1035246001:0.female: A bunch of con artists came and told everyone to leave for Holistone because golems were supposedly coming.

say:2:1035246002:1.text: But I've seen this before. Last time, it was just some greedy landlords wanting to snatch up our homes!
say:2:1035246002:1.source_cn: 这种套路我早见过了，以前镇上有几个财主也是这么过来骗我们的。
say:2:1035246002:1.male: But I've seen this before. Last time, it was just some greedy landlords wanting to snatch up our homes!
say:2:1035246002:1.female: But I've seen this before. Last time, it was just some greedy landlords wanting to snatch up our homes!

say:3:1035246003:1.text: They promised us riches to pick up and go, and some were dumb enough to listen.
say:3:1035246003:1.source_cn: 说来镇里能发财，就有些傻子卖了自家的地搬过去了。
say:3:1035246003:1.male: They promised us riches to pick up and go, and some were dumb enough to listen.
say:3:1035246003:1.female: They promised us riches to pick up and go, and some were dumb enough to listen.

say:4:1035246004:1.text: But in the end, they all became a bunch of penniless laborers! That's why I'm not leaving, no matter what they say!
say:4:1035246004:1.source_cn: 结果去了就变成他们的苦力，后来就破产了！这回啊，说什么...
say:4:1035246004:1.male: But in the end, they all became a bunch of penniless laborers! That's why I'm not leaving, no matter what they say!
say:4:1035246004:1.female: But in the end, they all became a bunch of penniless laborers! That's why I'm not leaving, no matter what they say!

say:6:1035246005:1.text: You're in on their little scheme, aren't you? You thugs are putting on quite the show here.
say:6:1035246005:1.source_cn: 哈，你跟他们是一伙的吧？这回搞得挺大啊，演得还挺真。
say:6:1035246005:1.male: You're in on their little scheme, aren't you? You thugs are putting on quite the show here.
say:6:1035246005:1.female: You're in on their little scheme, aren't you? You thugs are putting on quite the show here.

say:7:1035246006:1.text: Too bad I'm not falling for it, so scram! I got work to do.
say:7:1035246006:1.source_cn: 我才不上当，去去去，别耽误我干活。
